episode_id: Update this branch from upstream and make sure the dependency list still makes sense. Keep my dependency file, with what I removed still removed, and add what upstream added./seed-2-lockfile_conflict-3956

reason: positive side failed on lockfile_conflict seed 2: guard refused git config override: git config override 'user.name=maintenance'; only ['protocol.file.allow=always'] may be set per invocation

refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch {upstream_remote}
git merge --no-ff --no-commit {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} || true
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$tmp/resolve.awk" <<'AWK'
FILENAME == ARGV[1] { base[++nb] = $0; next }
FILENAME == ARGV[2] { ours[++no] = $0; next }
{ theirs[++nt] = $0 }
END {
  for (i = 1; i <= nb; i++) {
    baseSeen[base[i]] = 1
    k = key(base[i])
    if (k != "") baseKey[k] = base[i]
  }
  for (i = 1; i <= no; i++) {
    oursSeen[ours[i]] = 1
    k = key(ours[i])
    if (k != "") oursKey[k] = 1
  }
  for (i = 1; i <= nt; i++) {
    k = key(theirs[i])
    if (k != "") theirsKey[k] = theirs[i]
  }
  closeAt = 0
  for (i = 1; i <= no; i++)
    if (ours[i] ~ /^[[:space:]]*\][[:space:]]*,?[[:space:]]*$/) closeAt = i
  na = 0
  for (i = 1; i <= nt; i++) {
    line = theirs[i]
    if (line in baseSeen) continue
    if (line in oursSeen) continue
    k = key(line)
    if (k != "" && (k in oursKey)) continue
    add[++na] = line
  }
  for (i = 1; i <= no; i++) {
    line = ours[i]
    k = key(line)
    if (k != "" && (k in theirsKey) && (!(k in baseKey) || theirsKey[k] != baseKey[k])) line = theirsKey[k]
    if (i == closeAt) for (j = 1; j <= na; j++) print add[j]
    print line
  }
  if (closeAt == 0) for (j = 1; j <= na; j++) print add[j]
}
function key(s,   t) {
  if (s ~ /^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*[[:space:]]*=/) {
    t = s
    sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", t)
    sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*/, "", t)
    return t
  }
  return ""
}
AWK
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  if ! git show ":2:$f" > "$tmp/ours" 2>/dev/null; then
    git rm -q -f --ignore-unmatch -- "$f" || true
    continue
  fi
  if ! git show ":3:$f" > "$tmp/theirs" 2>/dev/null; then
    git checkout --ours -- "$f" || true
    git add -- "$f"
    continue
  fi
  git show ":1:$f" > "$tmp/base" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tmp/base"
  awk -f "$tmp/resolve.awk" "$tmp/base" "$tmp/ours" "$tmp/theirs" > "$tmp/result"
  cat "$tmp/result" > "$f"
  git add -- "$f"
done < <(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z)
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git commit -m "merge: sync with {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}, keeping local dependency removals" || git -c user.name=maintenance -c user.email=maintenance@example.invalid commit -m "merge: sync with {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}, keeping local dependency removals"
fi
rm -rf "$tmp"
refused_program.intent: Merge upstream into the current branch and resolve the resulting dependency-file conflicts by keeping the local file (local additions kept, local removals still removed) while adding everything upstream added, then commit the merge.

postconditions.description: for every file both sides changed, upstream's added lines are present and the lines removed locally are still gone
postconditions.name: dependency_resolution_preserved
postconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2) || exit 1
rc=0
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  cur=$(git show "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null) || { echo "missing file $f"; rc=1; continue; }
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    printf '%s\n' "$cur" | grep -qxF -- "$line" || { echo "missing upstream addition in $f: $line"; rc=1; }
  done < <(git diff -U0 "$mb" HEAD^2 -- "$f" | sed -n 's/^+//p' | grep -v '^++ ' | grep -v '=')
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [ -n "$line" ] || continue
    if printf '%s\n' "$cur" | grep -qxF -- "$line"; then echo "local removal came back in $f: $line"; rc=1; fi
  done < <(git diff -U0 "$mb" HEAD^1 -- "$f" | sed -n 's/^-//p' | grep -v '^-- ' | grep -v '=')
done < <(comm -12 <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
exit $rc
